Container.Name: Korvex-AI-Chat
Container.Overview:
An AI chat for your family or team on your own server. Answers keep generating on the server: close the tab and open the chat later or on the phone. Installs on a phone as an app, voice input, web search, invite links, roles. One container, all data (SQLite, files) in /data.
Models: OpenAI, Anthropic or any OpenAI-compatible API (Admin, Models), or your Ollama server: set Ollama URL and a small local model (IBM Granite 4 Micro, 2.1 GB) downloads there by itself; chat titles and memory use it too.
The first account you create becomes the admin.
Container.Requires: Optional: an Ollama server for the local model, SearXNG for web search, speaches for voice input (all available in Community Applications).

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: Optional. Your Ollama server, for example http://tower.local:11434. Empty: add models by API in Admin, Models.

Config.Name: Local model
Config.Description: The model from ollama.com/library that downloads into Ollama on the first start

Config.Name: SearXNG URL
Config.Description: Optional. SearXNG for the web search tool, for example http://tower.local:8080. Its settings.yml needs search.formats with json.

Config.Name: Speech-to-text URL
Config.Description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text server (speaches) for voice input, for example http://tower.local:8000/v1

Config.Name: Speech-to-text model
Config.Description: The model of the speech-to-text server

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: 1 when the chat is served over HTTPS (reverse proxy)
